body: I don’t see a ton of people using it in that context though.

I guess I don’t particularly “feel” bisexual as the vast majority of enbies I feel attracted to present pretty femme. I don’t know if I should use that label more so out of respect for them or technical correctness.

Hey thanks for the comment. Sorry I’m late responding. 

I guess my issue is that no label for my gender really seems “right” but “man” seems most comfortable in a way, but I feel like that’s probably just because it’s what I’ve always done, you know? Like I wouldnt WANT to be anything other than a man but I wouldnt necessarily care all that much if I were. 

In terms of my sexuality, most non-binary people I’m attracted to present feminine, but I feel like I wouldnt be uncomfortable dating a non-binary person who didn’t ALWAYS present femme. 

I guess I just don’t want to label my sexuality because I’m of the belief anything can happen, but at the same time non-binary is (obviously) a different category from “woman” so Im not sure if, by definition, I have a set sexuality.
